mapper.select: SELECT * FROM risk_rule WHERE region = #{region} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY scene ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_rule SET action = #{action}, threshold = #{threshold}, window_seconds = #{windowSeconds}, risk_score = #{riskScore}, enabled = #{enabled}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND region = #{region} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_event(region, scene, user_id, device_fingerprint, ip, biz_id, risk_score, decision, hit_rules, reason, dispose_status) VALUES(#{region}, #{scene}, #{userId}, #{deviceFingerprint}, #{ip}, #{bizId}, #{riskScore}, #{decision}, #{hitRules}, #{reason}, #{disposeStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM risk_event WHERE id = #{id} AND region = #{region}
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_event SET dispose_status = #{disposeStatus}, dispose_remark = #{disposeRemark}, disposed_by = #{disposedBy}, disposed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND region = #{region}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, user_count AS userCount, blocked AS blocked, last_user_id AS lastUserId FROM device_fingerprint WHERE region = #{region} AND fingerprint = #{fingerprint}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_fingerprint(region, fingerprint, user_count, last_user_id) VALUES(#{region}, #{fingerprint}, 1, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE device_fingerprint SET last_user_id = #{userId}, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , user_count = user_count + 1 WHERE region = #{region} AND fingerprint = #{fingerprint}
UPDATE device_fingerprint SET risk_hit_count = risk_hit_count + 1, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE region = #{region} AND fingerprint = #{fingerprint}
